moduleTitle: CS Induction - Building Your Web Presence

units.title: Building Your Portfolio Website
units.description: In this unit, you will build the first version of your own portfolio website using HTML and CSS. You will learn how to structure a web page, style it, and create common portfolio components: a skills list, project cards, an experience timeline and a contact section. By the end of this unit, you will have a personal portfolio template that you can keep developing throughout your course.
